  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER / DECEMBER 2024  
  SUBJECT: CSE 2123/CSE_2123 - DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [CSE 2123]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Reduce the number of states in the following state diagram and design a synchronous sequential       (5)  
  circuit for the reduced state diagram using T-flipflops.  
  
  
1B)               Define the power dissipation in the CMOS logic gates. Design a 2-input OR gate using CMOS logic. (3)  
1C)               Draw a logic diagram using 2-input NOR gates only to implement the following function:               (2)  
  
  
2A)               Using K-map simplification, design a code converter with minimum number of logic gates that          (5)  
  converts a self-complimenting 8-4-2-1 to Excess-3 equivalent of BCD. Draw the logic diagram and  
  write the dataflow Verilog code for the same with proper syntax.  
2B)               Design an optimal circuit for BCD to seven segment decoder using logic gates. The seven-segment (3)  
  LED designation is as shown in the figure 2B. It requires a logic high to make a particular LED of  
  the segment to glow.  
  
  
2C)               Using 2-to-1 multiplexer, design a combinational circuit with three inputs and one output in which   (2)

the output will be 1 only when the input is even.  
3A)   Design and illustrate 4-bit shift register with the parallel load that operates according to the following (5)  
  function table:  
  
  
3B)   Outline the SR flip flop with logic diagram using NAND gate, truth table, Characteristic equation and (3)  
  excitation table.  
3C)   Represent the below FSM in form of an ASM chart.                                                           (2)  
  
  
4A)   You are tasked with designing a digital circuit for a security monitoring system that checks the           (5)  
  status of a 4-bit sensor array, where each bit (A3, A2, A1, A0) represents a sensor's status (0 =  
  inactive, 1 = active). The circuit should count the number of active sensors (1's in the input) and  
  output this count in binary. Develop an ASM chart and control circuit to represent the operation of  
  this circuit.  
4B)   Design a three-bit up/down counter using D flip-flops in Verilog. It should include a control input        (3)  
  called Up/Down. If Up/Down = 0, then the circuit should behave as an up-counter. If Up/Down = 1,  
  then the circuit should behave as a down-counter.  
4C)   Brief Ring counter and write Verilog code that represents an eight-bit ring counter.                       (2)  
5A)   Design a Bit-Counting circuit to count the number of bits in a register, that has the value 1. Draw        (5)  
  and explain the Datapath circuit and control circuit for the same.  
5B)   Realize synchronous 3-bit gray code up-counter using T-flipflops with an appropriate sequence              (3)  
  diagram, excitation table, and logic diagram.  
5C)   Design a MOD-6 ripple counter using a T-flipflops and explain its working using a timing diagram.          (2)
